No limo. Known nit: with both cars facing the camera and the lake on screen-left, a careful viewer could read them as northbound, while the gantry sign in D1 says SOUTH. Follow-up to your review ("you can still see bits of color when she's in the driver's seat"): she is now in colour behind the windshield, face, orange headphones and the jacket band at her hands. The engrave pass had greyed her (too small for its matte), so the raw take is laid back inside a soft window round her.

'MEN IN / SHADES' and 'AND / SUITS' are cut into the black lenses as white-line woodcut capitals that arrive as outlines and are then cut solid, word by word on the singing. No lower third. The close-up runs one beat into the next shot so 'suits' can be read; the window shot now starts at 32.36.
